summary: This experimental document introduces Model-Based Metrics, a way to judge whether an Internet path can be expected to meet a target transport performance for bulk data. It does this by running diagnostic tests on successive subpaths rather than on the whole path at once. The approach tests the network against a model of how a transport protocol should behave.

eli5.summary: To check whether a long road is fast enough, you test it one short piece at a time. This does that for internet paths carrying big downloads.

questions: how to test if a path supports a target throughput
